SelectorQuery SelectorQuery.in(Component component)

Change the selection scope of the selector to the custom component.

Parameter

Component component

Custom component instance.

Return Value

SelectorQuery

Sample Code

Component({
  queryMultipleNodes (){
    const query = ma.createSelectorQuery().in(this)
    query.select('#the-id').boundingClientRect(function(res){
      res.top // Upper boundary coordinates of the #the-id node in the component.
    }).exec()
  }
})
